title: The Harvest of Cold Spring
author: Sebastian Nakamura
blurb: Tamsin Whitlock, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, has spent twenty years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
